standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.nvfuser,sdpa: 推荐组合,也是这个选择器里唯一的取值:nvFuser 管融合、SDPA 管注意力。逐个分量的解释见下面「补充说明」。

standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.sdpa: Leans on SDPA, for chasing down problems.
optionDescriptions.nvfuser,sdpa: The recommended combination, and the only value in this selector: nvFuser handles fusion, SDPA handles attention. See 'Additional notes' below for the individual components.

advanced.principle: auto 自动选择；nvfuser / torchcompile / sdpa 用于对照或排障。

advanced_en.principle: auto selects automatically; nvfuser / torchcompile / sdpa are for comparison or troubleshooting.
